Experience, Product Innovation, Enterprise Platform Modernization, Data Modernization, AI Readiness, Engineering Excellence and Digital Application and Maintenance Operations (DAMO). </p> <p>You will be inheriting one large portfolio in the Retail space based on which you will grow the existing account, and acquire new accounts based on your network, your industry expertise and our marketing activities and in close collaboration with your account team, our industry and service line specialists and the RCTT market organization. </p> <p>As a Client Principals, you are responsible for the entire sales cycle (lead generation through proposal, contract negotiation and closure) as well as client relationship management, account strategy and planning, joint delivery governance and project reviews. </p> <p>This includes e.g. </p> <p>● Understand the industry context, the customer problem and define mutual value ● Develop and execute on key account plans and overall go-to-market </p> <p>● Acquire and nurture senior client relationships on strategic accounts </p> <p>● Achieve established revenue and profitability targets </p> <p>● Work closely with the account leadership team (consisting e.g. of the account tech director and account delivery director) </p> <p>● Actively participate in the go-to-market plan creation/refinement for your account as well as for the industry vertical (RCTT), and </p> <p>● Report account activity, opportunity status and other details to the RCTT leadership (portfolio director)</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li> Establish, build, and maintain long-term, value-based relationships with a growing number of senior client stakeholders.</li> <li> Farm and manage between one and three accounts at a time (including 1-2 prospect accounts). </li> <li> Drive $20 million to $50 million in revenue per year from accounts to meet or exceed profitability targets. </li> <li>Ensure the creation and execution of existing account strategies, and build “win-win” value propositions at the company and individual levels. </li> <li>Help develop a range of IP and best practices around client and portfolio development in order to build the client base into a significant strategic asset. </li> <li>Approach client executives as true business partners versus software delivery partners, expanding the company’s breadth and depth to its full potential. </li> <li> Work on continuous margin improvement in sold and delivered margin.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li> A deep understanding of the retail (and ideally also the consumer goods) industry, familiarity with the main industry trends and drivers as well as relevant players (e.g. eco-system partners). </li> <li>A strong network in the industry. </li> <li> Experience working in many different executive revenue-generating roles requiring strong business acumen. </li> <li>Success managing and developing sophisticated senior client relationships and strategic business partnerships across the C-suite. </li> <li>Experience contributing to a clients’ business using a highly consultative and solution-oriented approach. </li> <li>Ability to drive thought leadership and innovation experience for clients.</li> <li>Ability to influence decisions by bringing in relevant industry trends and client stories on innovation and digital disruption. </li> <li>Experience in agile (custom) software development project delivery with the ability to understand the momentum of technical projects and the challenges a highly technical team will face in project execution.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li> A strategic thinker, with the ability to translate concepts and ideas into practical and tactical action and the skills to create value propositions for clients. </li> <li> A goal-oriented self-starter, with strong consultative instincts and skills who quickly and easily establishes rapport and credibility. </li> <li>Comfortable seeking out and interfacing with external constituents, and has the personal and social attributes to create and then manage effective long-lasting relationships.</li> <li> Skilled at negotiation and working in an ecosystem with external partners.</li> <li> Must be able to craft visions and adopt progressive points of view regarding the future, and rally people around the agendas that drive change. </li> <li>Thinks strategically, but also is highly skilled at execution in a complex environment with multiple stakeholders. </li> <li>A leader who inspires and grows a team who understands what it means to “put the team over self” .</li> <li> The ability to lead and motivate account and software development teams with creativity,imagination, energy, and enthusiasm. </li> </ul> </div> <div class="inner-content"> <p><strong>Important things to know</strong></p> <p>Projects are almost exclusively on customer site, so candidates should be flexible and open to travel. </p> <p>Not quite ready to apply? Or maybe this isn’t the right role for you? That’s OK, you can stay in touch with our digital leaders by joining Perspectives, our network for business insights in technology </p> <p>It is the policy of ThoughtWorks, Inc. to provide a work environment free of discrimination. The Company will take affirmative action to ensure applicants and ThoughtWorks employees are treated without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ethnic origin, veteran status, family status, disability, sexual orientation, gender expression or gender identity. This also includes individuals who are perceived to have any of the aforementioned attributes. ThoughtWorks will adhere to all federal, state, and municipal laws and regulations governing employment.</p> <p> </p> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.</p> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Remote</p> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Pre- & Post-Sales Customer Engineer, Enterprise
description: <h2>The Team + The Role</h2> <p>Pendo’s <strong>Customer Engineering team</strong> is the technical backbone of the <em><strong>pre- and post-sales customer motion.</strong></em></p> <p>The team brings together work across Customer Success, Technical Account Management, and Solutions Engineering into one full-lifecycle technical owner. Customer Engineering helps customers connect technical execution to business outcomes and realize the value of their investment in Pendo.</p> <p>As a <em><strong>Senior Customer Engineer </strong></em> you will own strategic and complex Enterprise accounts across acquisition, implementation, adoption, expansion, and escalation. You will lead technical strategy for complex deployments, resolve ambiguous customer challenges, and partner closely with account teams to drive retention, expansion, and customer value. Your impact will extend beyond your own accounts through playbooks, coaching, repeatable fixes, and workflow improvements that raise the capability of the broader Customer Engineering team.</p> <p>This role is based in our <strong>London office. </strong></p> <h2>What this looks like day-to-day</h2> <ul> <li><strong>New customer acquisition and selling:</strong> Partner with Account Directors on <strong>pre-sales </strong>motions for <em><strong>new customer acquisition, product expansion, and growth across lines of business.</strong></em> You identify customer pain, craft and deliver tailored demos, and lead technical evaluations through requirements gathering, success criteria, installation guidance, and hands-on workshops.</li> <li><strong>Quarterly business outcomes:</strong> Drive measurable improvement in customer health, retention, expansion, and technical resolution across strategic accounts. You contribute at least one reusable framework, playbook, or process that other Customer Engineers use and become a trusted advisor to Account Directors on account health and technical strategy.</li> <li><strong>Adoption, expansion, and growth:</strong> Identify opportunities to <em><strong>expand adoption </strong></em>across underutilized features, untapped products, and new lines of business. When adoption stalls, you diagnose root causes, design a path forward, and connect technical work to measurable business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Complex implementations and value realization:</strong> Lead onboarding for strategic customers, including planning, implementation, integrations, and training. You build customer-specific implementation playbooks, guide complex deployments with executive visibility, and ensure customers realize value during onboarding and over time.</li> <li><strong>Team capability building:</strong> Build playbooks, document repeatable fixes, coach peers, and improve how Customer Engineering work gets done across the team. You use AI tools to accelerate content creation, surface patterns across accounts, and share practical workflow findings with the broader team.</li> <li><strong>Early account impact:</strong> Assess account health, risks, stakeholder relationships, and the highest-priority problems to solve within your portfolio. You establish trust with Account Directors and customer stakeholders, then independently lead complex customer interactions that move accounts forward.</li> <li><strong>Technical escalation:</strong> Serve as an escalation point for complex technical challenges raised by other Customer Engineers. You resolve ambiguous problems with multiple variables and tradeoffs, involving Product or Engineering only when truly needed.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are</h2> <p>Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.</p> <p><em><strong>You're a builder, not a maintainer.<br></strong></em>You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Customer Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.</p> <p><em><strong>You're AI-curious - genuinely.<br></strong></em>You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.</p> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Passion for working with customers and building strong and impactful customer relationships</li> <li>5 to 8 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, Customer Engineering, implementation, professional services, or solutions architecture.</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and REST APIs, with the ability to architect and troubleshoot complex front-end implementations.</li> <li>Proven experience managing strategic Enterprise accounts with executive-level stakeholders, competing priorities, and complex technical or business requirements.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems involving multiple variables, constraints, and tradeoffs.</li> <li>Experience connecting technical execution to business outcomes such as retention, expansion, ROI, and value realization.</li> <li>Hands-on use of AI tools for account research, content creation, or workflow automation, with demonstrated integration into day-to-day work rather than light experimentation.</li> <li>Experience mentoring or coaching more junior technical team members.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with Pendo, digital adoption platforms, product analytics, or in-app experience tooling in an enterprise environment.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with mobile app development, including Swift, Android, or React Native.</li> <li>Familiarity with data architecture, AI or machine learning concepts, or advanced analytics instrumentation.</li> <li>Track record of building reusable frameworks, playbooks, or processes that were adopted by a broader team.</li> </ul> <h2>About Pendo</h2> <p>Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.</p> <p><strong>Pendo Core Values:</strong> Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week in London, UK </p> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong> Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.</p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong> Comprehensive, top-tier coverage (medical, dental, life) combined with pension match, equity, and high-value lifestyle perks.</p> <p><strong>EEOC:</strong> We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.</p> <p><strong>Accessibility:</strong> Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: ----- All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior IT Analyst
description: About The Role The Senior IT Analyst is the principal in-house resource responsible for day-to-day IT support, providing first and second-line user support and day-to-day IT operations for approximately 80 users. As the principal person responsible for day-to-day IT operations, they will take ownership of incidents and service requests across the support lifecycle rather than operating solely as an escalation resource. This is a broad, senior analyst role for someone who is technically capable, comfortable working independently and able to manage competing priorities. The postholder will respond directly to users, resolve routine enquiries and requests, investigate more complex issues through to resolution and coordinate external technology suppliers where specialist expertise is needed. Alongside business-as-usual responsibilities, the role will support and deliver smaller technology projects and service improvements. By keeping FAIRR’s technology secure, reliable and easy to use, the role enables colleagues to focus on delivering FAIRR’s mission with investors and partners worldwide. Key Outcomes & Accountabilities OUTCOME 1: Users receive dependable, responsive IT support, with issues owned and resolved end to end Act as the principal in-house point of contact for day-to-day IT support, providing both first and second-line assistance according to operational needs. Resolve straightforward incidents and requests promptly, while taking the lead on more complex technical issues requiring deeper investigation and second-line expertise. Own and manage incidents and service requests from initial contact through to resolution, including access, software, equipment, permissions and non-standard user requirements, coordinating third-party suppliers or specialist support when required. Monitor recurring issues, identify root causes and implement practical improvements to reduce repeat incidents. Maintain accurate support records and produce clear information on service volumes, performance, trends and user experience. OUTCOME 2: Joiners, movers and leavers have the right access and equipment at the right time, and no more Coordinate all IT activities for joiners, movers and leavers in collaboration with HR and relevant managers. Create, amend and remove user accounts, licences, group memberships, permissions and application access accurately and on time, including removal of leaver access no later than the end of their last working day (or earlier where instructed by P&C). Prepare, issue, recover and securely manage laptops, mobile devices, peripherals and other IT equipment. Perform periodic access reviews and maintain appropriate evidence of approvals and completed actions. Manage shared, service and other non-person accounts, ensuring ownership, purpose and access are recorded. Where instructed by P&C or the Senior IT Manager, securely preserve or retrieve account and device data to support subject access requests, investigations or legal matters, maintaining confidentiality throughout. OUTCOME 3: IT changes are implemented in a controlled way with minimal disruption Plan, assess, document, communicate and implement routine IT changes in a controlled manner. Ensure changes have appropriate approvals, testing, implementation steps, back-out arrangements and post-change review where proportionate. Maintain the IT change schedule and coordinate activities to minimise disruption to users and business operations. Communicate planned changes clearly to affected users and stakeholders. Where changes need to take place outside normal working hours, schedule these in advance with the Senior IT Manager’s agreement (see Section 8). OUTCOME 4: IT services and workplace technology operate reliably and are used effectively and securely Administer Microsoft 365 and other cloud applications used by the organisation, including routine configuration, licence and user administration. Support laptops, mobile devices, meeting-room technology, printers, connectivity and standard workplace applications. Coordinate hardware repairs, replacements, warranty cases, software renewals and operational supplier activities. Maintain user guides, knowledge articles, standard operating procedures and support documentation. Provide practical guidance and training that helps users make effective and secure use of technology. OUTCOME 5: IT records, controls and evidence are complete, current and audit-ready Maintain complete and accurate asset, software, licence, supplier and other operational IT registers. Record equipment allocation, ownership, status, location, lifecycle and disposal information, and perform periodic reconciliations. Follow and help maintain IT policies, standards, procedures and control evidence. Complete routine operational checks and scheduled control activities, escalating risks, exceptions or control failures promptly. Support audits, reviews and compliance activities by providing accurate records and evidence. Handle devices, accounts and information in line with security, privacy and records-management requirements. Support compliance with UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018 (as amended by the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025), including immediately escalating any suspected personal data breach to the Data Protection Lead so that the organisation can meet the 72-hour ICO reporting deadline where applicable. OUTCOME 6: Small projects and improvements are delivered and technology keeps getting better Deliver or support small IT projects, upgrades, application roll-outs and service improvements. Gather requirements, coordinate suppliers, plan user communications, support testing and manage implementation activities. Identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, efficiency and the user experience. Keep project actions, risks, decisions, documentation and handover materials up to date. Success Measures Success in the role will be assessed through: Service delivery Users receive dependable and responsive first and second-line technical support, with routine and complex issues resolved effectively. Incidents and requests are responded to and resolved within agreed service levels. User satisfaction with IT support is consistently positive. Accuracy, security and control Incidents, requests, access changes and joiner, mover and leaver activities are completed accurately and on time. 100% of leaver accounts disabled by the end of the last working day; new joiners fully equipped and set up on day one. Operational records, registers and control evidence are complete, current and reliable. Periodic access reviews and asset reconciliations completed on schedule with no significant audit findings. Change and improvement Changes and small projects are delivered in a controlled way with minimal disruption. Recurring problems are reduced and practical improvements are implemented continuously. Feedback from the Senior IT Manager, colleagues and suppliers on collaboration, communication and ownership. Technical Expertise & Role-Specific Capability Essential Strong hands-on experience providing both first and second-line IT support within a modern workplace environment, with particular strength in diagnosing and resolving more complex technical issues. Demonstrable experience managing a broad range of incidents and service requests through their full lifecycle, from initial user contact to resolution. Practical experience of joiner, mover and leaver processes, identity administration, permissions and access control. Experience administering Microsoft 365 and supporting Windows devices, laptops, mobile devices and common business applications. Experience maintaining IT asset records, operational registers, procedures and control evidence. Understanding of proportionate change management, information security and data protection practices. Ability to troubleshoot methodically, make sound decisions and know when to engage specialist support. Experience coordinating external IT suppliers and seeing actions through to completion. Ability to organise a varied workload independently and balance urgent support needs with planned operational work. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical matters to non-technical users. Experience contributing to or delivering small IT projects and technology changes. Desirable Experience in a small organisation where the role covers a broad range of operational IT responsibilities. Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Autopilot, SharePoint and Teams administration. Experience with IT service management tools and ITIL-aligned working practices. Experience supporting SaaS applications and coordinating managed service, cyber security or other specialist partners. Relevant technical or service management certification (e.g. Microsoft 365 / Azure certifications, ITIL Foundation), or equivalent practical experience. Career Framework Expectations Our Career Framework provides a shared approach to development and performance across the organisation. It is built around four core pillars: Connect, Deliver, Focus and Lead, which outline the key behaviours and expectations expected at all levels. In this role, the pillars look like this: CONNECT — Building trust, relationships and collaboration Collaborative and able to build effective relationships with users, colleagues and suppliers. Technically credible, user-focused and committed to providing a high-quality service. DELIVER — Driving outcomes and execution Proactive and self-sufficient, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Calm and organised when handling competing priorities or service disruption. FOCUS — Applying expertise and driving improvement Detail-oriented and disciplined about keeping records, documentation and actions up to date. Curious and improvement-minded, with a willingness to learn and adapt. LEAD — Leading self, others and organisational success Practical and proportionate, applying appropriate control without unnecessary bureaucracy. Role-models secure and responsible use of technology and shares knowledge so colleagues become more self-sufficient. Organisational Values We are change makers: keeps the technology behind FAIRR’s work dependable, so colleagues can spend their time on the mission rather than on IT problems. We collaborate: works closely with HR, managers, colleagues and suppliers to deliver a joined-up service. We innovate: looks for better, simpler and more secure ways of working, and delivers improvements that last. We act with integrity: handles privileged access, devices and personal data responsibly, confidentially and transparently. Additional Information Working Arrangements Hybrid working from near Marble Arch (Oxford Street), London, UK, in line with FAIRR’s organisational working arrangements. Normal working hours are 9.00am–5.30pm, Monday to Friday. Because much of the role is hands-on (devices, meeting-room technology, joiner set-up), the postholder will be expected to work on site at least 3 days per week and on key operational days such as new starter inductions. Occasional work outside normal hours may be required for planned changes or urgent incidents. This will be agreed in advance wherever possible and recognised through time off in lieu in line with FAIRR policy. Travel Requirements Occasional travel within London and the UK may be required (e.g. supplier visits, training or events). International travel is not an expected part of the role. Salary Range To be confirmed during recruitment stage. Benefits Benefits will be provided in line with FAIRR’s standard employee benefits package. Pre-Employment Checks Appointment is subject to proof of the right to work in the UK, satisfactory references and, because the role holds privileged system access, a Basic DBS criminal record check. Information will be handled in line with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and data protection law. Equal Opportuni

title: Financial Crimes Framework & Innovations Manager
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We’re looking for a Financial Crime Framework & Innovation Manager to lead our KYC Framework & Controls team in Pleo’s first line of defence. The team owns our financial crime framework across the UK and EU/EEA, covering KYC, AML/CFT and sanctions screening. You’ll lead a team of specialists while staying hands-on, owning change end to end across multiple entities and jurisdictions. Compliance is a given; the bigger opportunity is using AI and technology to cut manual effort and sharpen our controls. We welcome all backgrounds, so apply even if you don’t tick every box. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our DK/EEA MLRO and lead a remote team of five financial crime specialists. You’ll partner with Operations, who run our KYC processes, plus Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance and our separate transaction monitoring team. What you’ll be doing As a Financial Crime Framework & Innovation Manager, you will: Own and evolve Pleo’s financial crime framework for KYC, AML/CFT and sanctions screening across the UK and EU/EEA Lead and support a remote team of specialists, building trust and a real sense of team Drive change end to end, from spotting the gap to embedding the fix with Operations Use automation and AI to reduce manual effort and improve decision quality Lead our move to a new screening vendor through to go-live Shape our readiness for the EU AML Regulation Manage regulatory audits and inspections, and help set the team’s annual strategy On the roadmap: the screening vendor migration (go-live planned for Q1) and the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. We’re also finalising a new financial crime operating model, so some responsibilities may shift. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Significant experience designing and improving financial crime frameworks, controls and operating models in the UK or EU Experience across multiple entities and jurisdictions, covering UK and EU/EEA requirements Experience managing specialists while staying hands-on A track record of leading change end to end, from stakeholders to delivery Demonstrable experience driving innovation, for example AI-enabled workflows or automated controls The ability to turn complex financial crime concepts into clear, practical guidance It’s a bonus if you have: Led a screening vendor migration or a similar system implementation Hands-on experience preparing for the EU AML Regulation You might come from a fintech or a bank. If you’re from a larger bank, show us where you’ve owned broad scope. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You want broad ownership across KYC, AML and sanctions You get energy from finding efficiencies and putting AI to work on real problems You lead specialists by building trust and giving them room This role is not a good fit for you if: You want a pure people-management role. You’ll be in the detail as well as leading You need fully settled scope. Our operating model is being finalised, and some responsibilities may move You’d rather lead an office-based team. Yours is fully remote, and connection takes deliberate effort How you’ll develop in this role In your first six months at Pleo, you’ll: Take ownership of the screening vendor migration and lead it through go-live Take day-to-day ownership of the EU AML Regulation programme Bring your remote team closer together Beyond that, you’ll lead the AI and efficiency agenda across financial crime, with room to grow your scope as the operating model matures. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we’re supportive of families and help you feel that you don’t have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring manager interview: A conversation with the DK/EEA MLRO about your experience and leadership. 45mins. Pleo Challenge: Walk us through the efficiency opportunities you see in one of our processes. 1 hour. Peer interview: 1 hour Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! We are receiving a really high volume of applicants but can only select so many for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Legal Counsel
description: At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade. Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now. Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement. Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway. The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work. The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it. title: Contractor Development Manager
description: About Plentific Plentific is pioneering real-time property operations for real-world impact. Our platform connects property owners, operators, service providers and residents, and covers more than 1.7 million properties and 5,000+ service providers. We believe property repairs, maintenance and management can and should work better for everyone. That means giving landlords more control, supporting trade professionals and strengthening the communities they serve. The Role Our clients, mainly social housing providers and local authorities, rely on a strong and reliable network of contractors for their repairs and maintenance works. When they need more capacity in a region or a trade, or a contractor for a specific project, we go out and find the right businesses and bring them onto Plentific. We're looking for a Contractor Development Manager to lead that effort. This is a business development role. You'll identify the contractors who fit our ideal contractor profile and make sure they register to the platform, get them verified and onboard them to the platform. We are looking for experience in business development rather than experience in our sector, and you'll have full support getting to know Plentific and the contractor market. What matters most is that you're proactive, persuasive and resilient, and that you enjoy finding the right contractors and seeing them through to their first job. What you'll do Grow our contractor network Find and reach out to contractors who match our ideal contractor profile. Introduce Plentific and our way of working, answer their questions, and explain what joining means for their business. Sign contractors up to Plentific marketplaces wherever there is a need in supply, and guide them through onboarding on the platform. Where a client needs a contractor for a specific project, find suitable businesses, explain the project requirements, discuss pricing and SLAs, and agree whether it's a good fit. Build channels to reach new contractors alongside direct outreach, such as trade associations, local networks, events and referrals. Verify contractors on the platform Review each contractor's submitted information and check their certificates and other documents against our requirements. Contractors can only start taking on jobs once every verification is complete. Chase missing or incorrect information so they get verified and onboarded quickly and reach their first job. Flag anything that doesn't meet our standards, and share ideas for improving how we verify contractors. Manage your contractor pipeline Own your contractor pipeline end to end, from contractors approached through to sign-ups, verification and active contractors, keeping accurate records of every contractor and conversation in our CRM. Track progress at each stage, understand where contractors drop off, and follow up with those who stall before they are live. Target supply where it is needed Use data to identify the regions and trades where we need more supply, and prioritise your outreach accordingly. Keep our ideal contractor profile sharp by feeding back on which contractors sign up, stay and perform well. Share what you hear from contractors about pricing, SLAs and ways of working, so we keep improving our offer. What we're looking for Essential Experience in business development, account management, acquisition or a similar role where you've found and won new customers, partners or suppliers. You're comfortable owning a pipeline from first contact to a live contractor, and tracking and reporting on progress at each stage. Excellent communication skills. You can explain a platform, pricing and service levels clearly to tradespeople and small business owners. Proactive, resilient and self-motivated, comfortable reaching out to people you haven't met, and organised enough to follow up consistently. Confident using a CRM and Google Workspace or similar tools, and quick to learn new systems. Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work, and keen to find new ways they can save time. Nice to have Minimum 4 - 5 years of experience in business development and/or acquisition. A track record of growing a customer, partner or supplier base. Experience in social housing, property, repairs and maintenance, facilities management or construction. Why Plentific You'll join a scale-up with ambitious growth plans and the backing to deliver them, in a role where your deals directly shape how the sector manages its homes. title: Head of PMO
description: About Us Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to manage repairs, maintenance, compliance, and contractor operations at scale. Our platform combines marketplace infrastructure, workflow software, automation, and operational analytics. It is designed for the complexity, volume, and regulatory demands of social housing, public sector property portfolios, and large residential operations. We are headquartered in London, with engineering and operations across the UK and Germany. We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you want to work on hard, real-world problems in the world's largest asset class, we would like to hear from you. Role purpose Plentific is standing up a Controlling PMO: a function with the mandate to set and enforce common delivery standards, hold a single, current view of the whole portfolio, and work directly with senior management to unblock the issues that put individual projects’ targets at risk. The PMO Lead owns this function day to day — coaching Programme and Project Managers (PMs) to a consistently high standard, building the portfolio-level reporting that gives leadership real visibility, and acting as the bridge between delivery teams and senior management when a decision or an unblock is needed. This is a hands-on, first-of-its-kind role at Plentific: the PMO Lead will stand up the standards, cadence, and reporting described below largely from scratch, and will be judged on how quickly the portfolio becomes visible, consistent, and genuinely governed as a result. Key responsibilities 1. Coach Programme & Project Managers, and hold the standard Own and continuously improve the standard toolkit every programme uses — charter, RAID log, status report, change log. Coach PMs on using the standards well — raising the general standard of programme management practice, not just chasing form-filling. Own the stage-gate review process: assess whether a programme is genuinely ready to pass each gate, and issue go/no-go sign-off. Set and enforce mandatory reporting — PMs submit standard, current status on a fixed cadence; the PMO follows up where reporting lapses. 2. Build and run portfolio-level reporting and governance Consolidate individual programme status into one current, accurate portfolio view of schedule, spend, risk, and resourcing. Own the portfolio tracker and the cadence of updates that feed it. Track cross-programme risks and dependencies; make sure each has a named owner and a clear escalation threshold. Prepare and present the portfolio report at each Steering Committee review. Track benefits realisation — confirm delivered programmes actually produced the outcome they were funded for. 3. Work with senior management to report and unblock Act as the primary escalation point when a programme risk or dependency needs a decision above the PM’s authority. Bring blockers to the right senior stakeholder quickly, with a clear ask and options — not just a status update. Represent delivery status and risk to senior management accurately and without spin, including when the news is difficult. Chair or co-chair the portfolio review, and prepare materials for Steering Committee meetings. Track follow-through on decisions and unblocks agreed with senior management, so they don’t silently drop. Authority and mandate This role carries a Controlling PMO mandate — meaning the successful candidate has the authority to require compliance, not just recommend it: Authority, via the PMO charter, to require compliance with standards and mandatory reporting across all active programmes. Owns sign-off at stage gates — a programme cannot proceed to the next phase without PMO gate approval. Is the named escalation path for cross-programme risk and resourcing conflicts. Does not directly manage PMs day to day: PMs remain people-managed within their business unit, with a functional (“dotted-line”) reporting relationship into the PMO for delivery standards, gate compliance, and escalation. Key relationships Executive Sponsor / Steering Committee — monthly portfolio reporting, escalation, gate decisions. Programme & Project Managers — coaching, mandatory reporting, gate reviews. Senior management / business leaders — status reporting, unblocking, resourcing conversations. PMO Analyst (future hire) — as the portfolio grows, this role would oversee a second PMO hire supporting reporting and gate reviews. How success is measured On-time delivery rate across active programmes. Forecast accuracy — how closely planned cost and effort track actuals over time. Share of active programmes with an up-to-date RAID log. Time from a risk being raised to being escalated to someone who can unblock it. Sponsor and PM confidence in delivery, tracked each quarter. Person specification Essential Proven experience running programme or project governance, ideally in a PMO capacity, in a fast-moving organisation. Comfortable holding people accountable to standards without owning their day-to-day work — a coaching style, not a command style. Strong stakeholder management skills; credible in the room with senior leadership. Confident synthesising status across multiple concurrent initiatives into a single, honest, current view. A clear, direct communicator, comfortable surfacing bad news early rather than letting it surface late. Desirable A formal programme/PMO qualification (e.g. P3O, PRINCE2, MSP, PMP). Experience standing up a PMO from scratch, or maturing one from a Supportive to a Controlling model. Familiarity with portfolio/PPM reporting tools. Benefits As you can see, we are quickly progressing with our ambitious plans and are eager to grow our team of doers to achieve our vision of managing over 2 million properties through our platform across various countries. You can help us shape the future of property management across the globe. Here’s what we offer: A competitive compensation package 25 days annual holiday + 1 additional day for every year served up to 3 years. Flexible working environment including the option to work abroad Private health care for you and immediate family members with discounted gym membership, optical, dental and private GP Enhanced parental leave Life insurance (4x salary) Employee assistance program Company volunteering day and charity salary sacrifice scheme Learning management system powered by Udemy Referral bonus and charity donation if someone you introduce joins the company Season ticket loan, Cycle to work, Electric vehicle and Techscheme programs Pension scheme Work abroad scheme Company-sponsored lunches, dinners and social gatherings Fully stocked kitchen with drinks, snacks, fruit, breakfast cereal etc. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Solutions Architect
description: About Plane Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agents We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that. About the role Our largest customers do not buy Plane off the shelf. A bank wants it behind their firewall with SSO tied to their identity provider; a defense contractor wants it air-gapped with a migration plan from three legacy tools at once. You will own the technical architecture for these deployments before the contract is signed and after, translating what a customer's infrastructure and compliance team requires into a Plane deployment that actually holds up. You will work directly with sales on the largest deals we run and with engineering when a customer's requirements push past what we support today. This role exists because our regulated-industry customers ask questions our sales team cannot answer alone, and our engineers should not have to answer on every call. What you'll do Own the technical architecture for enterprise and regulated-industry deployments, from the first discovery call through a signed statement of work. Design self-hosted and air-gapped Plane deployments that satisfy a specific customer's security review, not a generic best-practice checklist. Run technical discovery with customers whose infrastructure and compliance teams will pick apart every answer you give, and be right often enough that they trust the next one. Define the migration path when a customer moves off two or three existing tools at once, including what data does not survive the move and saying so up front. Work daily with sales on live deals and with engineering when a customer's requirements expose a real gap in the product, carrying that gap back as a specific, scoped request rather than a vague one. Answer the same security questionnaire in a slightly different format for the fourth time this month, because every regulated buyer's procurement process is its own small bureaucracy and none of them read each other's paperwork. What you'll bring You have designed and defended a technical architecture to a skeptical buyer , and you can walk us through one deal where the customer's own security or infrastructure team changed your design. You understand self-hosted and on-premises deployment beyond a docker-compose file , including networking, SSO and identity federation, and what changes when a customer runs the software instead of you. You can read a security questionnaire or compliance requirement and translate it into an actual deployment decision , not a reassurance. You are comfortable being the technical voice on a sales call , including the parts where the answer is no or not yet. You write technical documentation a customer's own engineers will actually follow , because you will not be in the room when they run it. Nice to haves You have worked pre-sales or post-sales in a solutions architecture, sales engineering, or technical account management role selling to regulated industries. You have contributed to Plane, run it self-hosted, or maintained another open project people rely on. You have shipped or supported deployments into banking, defense, healthcare, or air-gapped environments specifically. You have opinions about how AI agents should be permissioned and audited in an enterprise environment, and can defend them. Tech Backend : Python/Django, Golang, Node.js, Postgres, Redis Messaging : RabbitMQ, Kafka Infrastructure : AWS, Kubernetes, Rancher, self-hosted deployment via Docker and Helm Identity : SAML, OIDC, SCIM Everyday tools : GitHub, Plane (yes, we run on it), Figma, Slack Why Plane? Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead. The scope is real. We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both. The constraints make you better. Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer. The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production. We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role. Your name is on the work. The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part. If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you. Plane is an equal opportunity employer. HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it. Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity. Signing a contract is the easy part. Everything before it (multiple parties, several legal documents, opposing interests, a redlining process most companies still run through email attachments) is where contracting actually gets hard. That's the part of Juro you'll own. It's the most ambitious area of the product and the one with the most room to change how contracting feels for the people doing it day to day. We're not handing you a blank page. There's a roadmap in place and a team ready to build it. We want you shipping against it while you're forming your own view of the problem, then tell us which parts of it were wrong. Every PM at Juro is hired to make product bets that pay out . Great means that: the bets you own deliver real outcomes for customers quickly, and those outcomes show up in revenue. What you're here to do: Ship against the contract workflow roadmap in your first few weeks. Get close to the problem rapidly. Talk to customers and prospects yourself. Form your own view of the jobs to be done rather than inheriting ours. It's an agentic flow where "good redline" depends on the customer's playbook rather than any fixed answer, so a lot of the work is deciding what good means with customers and then holding engineering to it. It spans your team and our Agentic team, so some of what you own won't sit neatly in one place. Work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design and GTM to turn all of that into something people actually enjoy using. Measure whether any of it worked and be honest when it didn't. Iterate or pivot when necessary. Six months in, success looks like customers telling us unprompted that contracting in Juro got a lot more delightful and reaching for it in places they used to reach for Word. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub . To succeed here: Every Juror finds their balance across our four core principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day. Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles. On top of that, you have been part of a journey where: You've landed in a domain you knew nothing about and were making judgment calls within weeks. Ideally more than once. You've owned something complex and multi-quarter from discovery through launch and iteration + were accountable when it slipped. You've built for users you got to know directly, not through Sales or Customer Success. That means you've sat with them, watched them work and can tell us what they taught you. You've worked shoulder to shoulder with GTM and engineering through launches + have been the trusted go-to person for them in past companies. You understand why evals matter and how agentic loops work.* You run your own discovery. Customer calls, prospect calls, synthesising messy qualitative input into a clear view of what to build. You've brought ideas unprompted and built them without waiting for permission. Something small shipped in days beats a perfect spec written in weeks. Bonus if: You've owned the quality of an agentic system in production. Legal tech or contracting experience. You've worked on collaboration or multiplayer editing tools. *What we care about is that you will dig into how a system actually behaves when you need to: work out why a flow is producing rubbish, go back and forth with engineers until it isn't. You don't need to have done this full time. This job likely isn’t for you if: You need someone to teach you the domain before you can be useful. You'd rather run the process than talk to customers. You think of AI as something the engineers deal with. You treat design as a service that receives your specs. Here you'd decide what to build alongside a designer, not hand it over. You want a settled team and a clean remit. Our product org will change, and some of your scope will cut across other teams. You'd want to spend your first quarter rewriting the roadmap before shipping any of it. You've been managing PMs and want to carry on doing that. This is hands-on. title: Senior Financial Reporting Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London/Distrubuted across the UK | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 (depending on experience) ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Finance team</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a highly proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded Financial Reporting Senior Analyst to join our Financial Reporting team, and help us build a world-class finance function.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges coming up, like expanding into the European Union, introducing Monzo Mobile and Habito to our group, climate change reporting, continuing to grow our customer base, expanding our lending business, and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way while helping us optimize our financial reporting processes with the help of technology. You’ll join the Finance team and report to our Financial Reporting Manager.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supporting the full year end process, from drafting the annual report to working with external auditors until final sign-off. </li> <li>Supporting tight processes with our internal finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process.</li> <li>Understanding the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Working with our engineers and data teams to automate the production elements of the role, allowing you to focus on the parts of the role where your knowledge and skills provide the most value.</li> <li>Understanding our accounting system and making sure we are taking advantage of all its features to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Being responsible for ensuring our financial reporting policies, procedures and controls are up to date, relevant and useful for Monzo and importantly are scalable.</li> <li>Reviewing new products and the impact of new contracts, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Working with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Maintaining existing and developing new controls that protect our financial data and our balance sheet substantiation process.</li> <li>Supporting the production of ESG sustainability reporting and disclosures.</li> <li>Preparing monthly management and ad hoc reports, offering meaningful analysis of movements.</li> <li>Resolving miscellaneous inquiries and supporting the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified chartered accountant (ACA or CA) and ideally have audit experience combined with some financial reporting and control experience outside of practice. </li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls.</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors.</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds.</li> <li>You’re comfortable with leveraging data to automate reporting and drive efficiency (SQL skills would be a bonus).</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.</li> <li>Nice to have:</li> <ul> <li>Experience in a listed company or financial services regulated environment. </li> <li>Strong business partnering/commercial financial acumen. </li> <li>ESG reporting/audit of sustainability information (carbon footprint, CFD/CSRD).</li> </ul> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000 (depending on experience) ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role is based in our London office and we aim to come in as a team twice a week. We're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) if required.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial Hiring Manager Interview (30 Minutes) </li> <li>Role Specific Interview (60 Minutes) </li> <li>Behavioural Interview (45 Minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-SS1</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Regulatory Reporting Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London | 💰up to £55,000 (depending on experience) ➕ incentive awards tied to your performance | <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨ </p> <p><strong>⭐Our Regulatory team</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for<strong> </strong>a curious, adaptive and data-focused <strong>Regulatory Reporting Analyst</strong> with a strong attention to detail to join our regulatory reporting team at Monzo. The team is responsible for understanding our prudential regulatory reporting requirements, working on projects and submissions relating to these and collaborating with teams across Monzo.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Producing Monzo’s regulatory liquidity reporting, ensuring robust and consistent controls across all outputs to support regulatory compliance and internal governance requirements</li> <li>Documenting the applicable regulatory interpretations and communication</li> <li>Assisting the wider team produce Monzo’s capital and liquidity regulatory reporting and disclosures (including Pillar 3)</li> <li>Executing and improving the controls required to ensure regulatory reporting is timely, accurate and complete</li> <li>Ensuring all our regulatory reporting runs like clockwork</li> <li>Using data visualisation tools to build dashboards and facilitate sign-off and useful insights</li> <li>Designing brilliant ways to automate your work and leverage technology to ensure we scale with the business</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a good understanding and experience of producing LCR, NSFR, PRA110, ALMM returns</li> <li>You’re excited by data and have a sharp eye for detail</li> <li>You have knowledge of coding languages like SQL would be a bonus, although a willingness to learn is just fine </li> <li>You have a proven record of delivering to strict deadlines </li> <li>You want to automate or enhance recurring processes, particularly by leveraging technology, but know how to balance this with getting the actual reports out!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰up to £55,000 (depending on experience) ➕ incentive awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role is based in our London office on a hybrid basis. We expect 1 - 2 days per week working from the office.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 £200 allowance to spend on your work-from-home setup after completing your first full month with us.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Phone call with recruiter (30 mins)</li> <li>Initial call with hiring manager (30 mins)</li> <li>Technical interview with hiring manager and team member (45 mins)</li> <li>Monzo behavioural interview (30 min)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-NZ1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo.
